# pipegen_export/
#
# Place the PipeGen export folder contents here after running:
#   pipegen export --output pipegen_export/
#
# Required files (generated by PipeGen):
#   run.sh                  - generated DeepStream launch script
#   pipeline.json           - pipeline IR export
#   *.engine / *.trt        - TensorRT engine files (gitignored due to size)
#   requirements.txt        - PipeGen-generated requirements
#
# IMPORTANT: This folder must be present in the submitted source code.
# See INTEGRATION.md section 6 for the full submission structure.
